headline: Sensex and Nifty Set for Steady Start as Rebound Holds and Crude Prices Ease

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing crude oil prices provided relief to Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty.
Asian market cues and GIFT Nifty indicated a steady opening for Indian equities.
Markets showed resilience and rebounded after six consecutive weekly falls despite West Asia tensions.
Investors are closely watching global central bank policies including rate cycle impacts from the US Fed and Bank of Japan.
whatHappening: JPMorgan maintained an 'Overweight' rating on L&T, highlighting attractive valuation and strong growth outlook.
Bernstein upgraded NTPC Green, stating that execution challenges are already priced into the stock.
Polycab shares dropped 17% after the Ultravolt launch as investors evaluated competitive risks.
SME IPOs for Anand Seamless and Himalaya Nutravedics opened for public subscription today.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty are set for a steady opening, continuing momentum from recent gains driven by falling crude oil prices. Stock-specific action remains prominent with upgrades for L&T and NTPC Green, while Polycab experienced sharp decline following a product launch. Global central bank moves and GIFT Nifty cues continue to guide broader investor sentiment.
